rows.label: tlk44500184_01_msg0001
rows.name:
My goodness... Outlanders!
Outlanders are here! I've got
to tell everyone at once!

rows.label: tlk44500184_01_msg0002
rows.name:
From which country did you come?
How fare the other countries? You
must tell me the latest trends...

rows.label: tlk44500184_01_msg0003
rows.name:
Oh, sorry... It's been so long since
I've seen someone from outside that I
got excited.

rows.label: tlk44500184_01_msg0004
rows.name:
I never thought I'd get to talk to
someone from outside before I died...
